description: This file defines the UserSearchFilterParams class in the OrangeHRM system, used to encapsulate filtering parameters for user searches within the admin plugin. It extends a base FilterParams class and includes properties such as status, username, user role ID, employee number, and password existence, along with their respective getter and setter methods. It also specifies allowed sorting fields.

classes.name: UserSearchFilterParams
classes.description: A data transfer object that holds filter parameters for searching users, including criteria such as status, username, user role ID, employee number, and password existence, with default sorting set to username.

methods.name: getStatus
methods.description: Returns the status filter criterion, which can be true, false, or null.

methods.name: getUserRoleId
methods.description: Returns the user role ID filter criterion.

methods.name: setUserRoleId
methods.description: Sets the user role ID filter criterion.

methods.name: getEmpNumber
methods.description: Returns the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: setEmpNumber
methods.description: Sets the employee number filter criterion.

methods.name: hasPassword
methods.description: Returns whether the filter is for users with or without a password.

methods.name: setHasPassword
methods.description: Sets the password existence filter criterion.
